Unofficial PC port · work in progress

Killzone HD, native on PC

Project Vekta runs the PS3 remaster of the first Killzone as a native Linux or Windows program. The game's own PowerPC and Cell SPU code is translated to C++ ahead of time with ps3recomp and compiled on your machine; the PS3's system software is reimplemented around it, and the graphics are replayed on Vulkan. It is not an emulator and not a rewrite.

You need your own copy of the game. This project contains only the port: code, patches, tools and documentation. No game code, data, assets, keys or firmware are included or downloaded.

Every feature of the PS3 game, with its evidence

At a glance

  • Game: Killzone HD, PS3 (NPUA80856), from the Killzone Trilogy disc
  • Recompiler: ps3recomp v0.18.0 plus 102 patches
  • Platforms: Linux x64 native, Windows x64 (cross-built)
  • Graphics: Vulkan
  • CPU: x86-64 with AVX2
  • Online: nothing; the port makes no network connection
  • Licence: MIT

PC features

All optional, on a PC page inside the game's own Options and Pause menus:

  • Window, borderless or fullscreen; any resolution; internal resolution scale
  • V-Sync, VRR and a 30, 60 or 144 fps limit (the game clock follows)
  • AMD FSR 1 upscaling with RCAS sharpening; anisotropic filtering up to 16x
  • Widescreen Hor+ for 21:9, 32:9 and wider; field of view; HUD size and position
  • Presets: Original (PS3), Performance, Balanced, Quality
  • Keyboard and mouse with direct mouse look, mouse in menus, remappable keys
  • Xbox, PlayStation, Nintendo and generic controllers, with button prompts that follow the device
  • Stereo, 5.1 or 7.1 sound; game language; skip the opening movie
  • Local trophies, read from the game's own trophy set

The full list, with the PS3 parity table

Build it

On Linux, with your files in Game/:

git clone --recurse-submodules \
  https://github.com/gustavomorinaga/project-vekta
cd project-vekta
tools/check-game-files.py
tools/ps3recomp-patched.sh
tools/lift.sh
tools/setup-vfs.sh
tools/build.sh
tools/play.sh

Requirements and the Windows cross build: BUILDING.md.

Latest changes

Unreleased

  • The game's own MLAA anti-aliasing, reimplemented as a GPU compute pass equal to the SPU code (patches 2035 to 2037, KZ_MLAA=gpu|spu|off); the first frame no longer waits for the driver to compile it.
  • NVIDIA Reflex (Off, On, On + Boost) on the PC page, through VK_NV_low_latency2 (patch 2038).
  • In-game key capture for remapping screens (patch 4011).
  • An SPU write into a GPU-mapped range that overlaps one already unmapped is seen as GPU-mapped again (patch 2039), and the SPU poison-write diagnostic works with SPU_POISON_DMA_WATCH (patch 1019); both found by ps3recomp's own tests, which now run on the patched tree in CI (tools/tests/test_upstream_suite.sh, patch 0004).
  • An SPU that reserves a line while another SPU's plain write to it is being copied now loses the reservation at once, not at the next 10 ms poll (patch 1020, tools/tests/test_spu_put_recheck.sh).
  • The project page is generated whole by tools/website.py from docs/features.tsv, docs/SCREENSHOTS.md, docs/ROADMAP.md, this changelog and the patch series, and checked in CI; docs/FEATURES.md gains a section on the port itself (builds, frame rate, installer).
